text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH genqueue latency spike in us-east affecting /v1/generate and streaming endpoints. Error rate elevated, throttling observed. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

emily: Jordan oncall — can you confirm impact and ETA? @sre_jordan

sre_jordan: Jumping in. Seeing sustained queue depth increase and tail latency spikes. Root signals point to a scheduling regression in the fastgen queue. Investigating. ETA ~30m for mitigation plan.

ops_lee: Thanks. Do we have a temporary mitigation (rate limit, fallback model)? Recommend routing to gen-lite variant if available.

sre_jordan: Working on a hotfix to bump concurrent workers and enable fallback routing policy. Will also open a scaled-down canary to validate.

comms_kate: Heads up — need initial status page copy and customer-facing blurb if this impacts >5% of requests. Can you confirm rough %? @sre_jordan

sre_jordan: Early telemetry: approx 7% of generation requests getting >500ms extra latency, 1.2% errors from queue overflow. Affected region: us-east only. No data exposure.

product_ravi: Important: customers on Dedicated may see different behavior. Any SLA impact? @ops_lee

ops_lee: No SLA breach expected if mitigation completes in 1h. We'll mark as partial degradation for hosted API in us-east. Dedicated customers unaffected for isolated capacity.

emily: Drafting statuspage initial. Posting for quick review. Please react with :thumbsup: if ok, :eyes: if needs edits, or @legal_ana for wording checks.

comms_kate: paste the draft here and highlight customer-facing bits.

emily: Draft 1 (initial):

```
Title: Partial degradation - Text generation latency (US-East)
Status: Investigating
Impact: We are investigating elevated latency and increased errors for text generation requests served from the US-East region. Some customers may experience slower responses or transient errors. We estimate ~7% of generation requests currently affected.
Scope: Hosted API endpoints (/v1/generate, streaming) in us-east only. Dedicated and private deployments are not affected.
Next update: We will provide an update within 30 minutes or as we have more information.
```

comms_kate: I like it. Suggest small tweak on the Impact line to avoid citing a % until confirmed. Recommend: "A subset of customers may experience slower responses or transient errors."

emily: Updated draft (adjusted Impact):

```
Title: Partial degradation - Text generation latency (US-East)
Status: Investigating
Impact: A subset of customers may experience slower responses or transient errors when using text generation endpoints in the US-East region.
Scope: Hosted API endpoints (/v1/generate, streaming) in us-east only. Dedicated and private deployments are not affected.
Next update: We will provide an update within 30 minutes or as we have more information.
```

legal_ana: Quick legal check — wording fine. Avoid promising precise ETA; "within 30 minutes" is ok as a best-effort. No PII in copy.

product_ravi: Approve from product. Can we add "workarounds: use model-gen-lite or fallback routing"? Might help customers.

sre_jordan: We can add workaround note but mark as advanced. Adding:

```
Workaround: If you experience issues, consider routing to the "model-gen-lite" variant or retry with exponential backoff.
```

emily: Final draft ready with workaround. Posting for publish approval.

```
Title: Partial degradation - Text generation latency (US-East)
Status: Investigating
Impact: A subset of customers may experience slower responses or transient errors when using text generation endpoints in the US-East region.
Scope: Hosted API endpoints (/v1/generate, streaming) in us-east only. Dedicated and private deployments are not affected.
Workaround: If you experience issues, consider routing to the "model-gen-lite" variant or retry with exponential backoff.
Next update: We will provide an update within 30 minutes or as we have more information.
```

comms_kate: :thumbsup: from comms. Add note to internal ops playbook referencing runbook ID 2026-GQ.

ops_lee: Noted. I will publish when Jordan confirms mitigation runway.

sre_jordan: Mitigation validated on canary; enabling fallback routing globally in us-east now. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Automated update: mitigation step applied by sre_jordan at 1723460500. Queue depth declining.

sre_jordan: Metrics look good. Error rate down to baseline over last 5m. Rolling back temporary worker bump to normalize.

emily: Drafting resolved notice for statuspage. Posting for sign-off.

emily: Resolved draft:

```
Title: Resolved - Text generation latency (US-East)
Status: Resolved
Impact: The issue causing elevated latency and transient errors for text generation requests in the US-East region has been resolved. Normal service has been restored for affected endpoints.
Scope: Hosted API endpoints (/v1/generate, streaming) in us-east only.
Details: A scheduling regression in the genqueue caused increased queue depth; a mitigation (fallback routing + temporary concurrency adjustment) was deployed and validated.
Follow-up: A post-incident analysis will be published to customers within 72 hours.
```

legal_ana: Wording good. Add "no customer data was exposed" clause if true.

sre_jordan: Confirmed: no customer data exposed. Updated resolved draft accordingly.

comms_kate: Ready to publish initial + resolved. Emily, please publish initial update now and resolved notice when you get the green. I'll handle social/email bulletins.

emily: Published initial notice at 1723460100. Will publish resolved at 1723463500 once I get final confirmation.

ops_lee: Thanks all. Oncall handoff: I'll own post-incident follow-up and link to runbook. @product_ravi @comms_kate please sync for customer follow-ups.

product_ravi: Roger.

incident-bot: Incident resolved and closed at 1723463500. Tags: genqueue, us-east, partial-degradation, mitigation-deployed.

emily: Resolved notice published at 1723463500. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
